primary_ns: elapsed_ns: solve plus untouched original-ANF check, excluding evidence serialization
statistic: Median of seven paired comparator elapsed_ns / combined-metal elapsed_ns ratios
interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of paired-resampled medians; descriptive per-input intervals, not familywise guarantees
comparators: Every retained arm plus projection-cpu, wide-cpu, wide-metal, normalized-cpu, lookup-cpu and combined-cpu. Fastest CPU and fastest other actually executing GPU are identified independently per input and trial.
repeat_gate: Two complete admitted trials for each frozen input, all samples within the unchanged load threshold, all source/reference/proof/runtime binary identity checks pass, actual combined Metal execution, lower95 > 1 against every comparator in both trials. Preserve failures and CPU fallbacks. No automatic routing change.
limits: Physical Apple M4 Pro, fixed planted PDP inputs only. No inference about natural relation yield, full IC/rho, other hardware or asymptotic complexity. No automatic promotion.
